note: Worked example 3 (M5): the hand smoke spec for the vehicle vocabulary — a box body with two mirrored `wheel` composites hung underneath by `hangs-below`, each a ring tyre with its bore along X and a box hub `embedded` in it. Left/right is X and length is Z, the convention V9 mirrors about and V7 measures the wheel radius against. The M5 MVP-STUB here (a child of a mirrored part attached to instance 0, so the mirrored wheel had no hub) was closed in M6: per-instance children are the default, and this spec compiles to two tyres AND two hubs with no edit.
